**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 22 (Audit Rights) is the only audit/verification right binding us, and it lands squarely on the playbook's *preferred* position:

| Playbook (preferred) | § 22 |
|---|---|
| Max once / 12 months | "no more than once in any twelve-month period" ✔ |
| 30 days' written notice | "at least thirty days' prior written notice" ✔ |
| Business hours | "during normal business hours" + no unreasonable disruption ✔ |
| Off-site where possible | "conducted off-site where practicable" ✔ |
| Independent auditor under confidentiality | ✔ |
| Vendor cost unless underpayment > 5% | ✔ (5%, and only the *undisputed* shortfall) |
| No direct system access | Express bar on Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential info ✔ |

§ 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes the audited quantity issue absent fraud or demonstrable error). Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative record-keeping obligation, and a document-wide search found no other inspection, verification, monitoring or remote-access rights.
